target_customer: Business teams in sales, marketing, customer success, support and operations at mid-size and large companies (named customers include Peloton, SKIMS and OpenSea)
problem: Teams have customer data in warehouses and tools but cannot easily turn it into insights or automated actions; the early product surfaced insights from customer data and the current one builds AI agents that act across systems.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform subscription for AI agents with integrations; pricing not found
product_category: AI agent platform, previously customer analytics

founders.name: Tom Firth
founders.background_notes: YC page bio only says he likes data, software and AI and is based in NYC; no education or employers found.

founders.name: Ibby Syed
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in Tom Firth's YC bio; no profile found.

technical_complexity.rationale: At founding, analytics that sit on a customer's data warehouse and find insights required solid data engineering; the later agent platform with 200 plus integrations is standard engineering with some hard reliability work.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and workflows create some lock-in, but the company itself compares against Zapier, n8n, Clay and other automation tools, and large model vendors can copy agent builders.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. The company repositioned into AI agents and launched on Product Hunt in November 2025.

market_need_then: In 2022 companies were adopting data warehouses and wanted analytics on top of them; later demand shifted to AI agents. The early description said the product surfaced interesting insights from customer data.

branding.domain_note: Uses cotera.co rather than .com; no history found.

identity.mascot_or_character: Coco, the named agent builder assistant that also works inside Linear
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product claims such as the fastest way to build an AI agent

branding.brand_signature: Coco, the AI agent builder assistant
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch in November 2025 reportedly drew 123 upvotes and 7 comments.

brand_strength.rationale: Modest community signals (a Product Hunt launch, a named assistant) but no press about the brand itself found.

pivots.from: Customer analytics and predictive insights on the data warehouse
pivots.why: Not stated; a directory profile places this around 2023, which is unverified

outcome_analysis: Cotera started on warehouse-based customer analytics, then moved to an AI agent platform, reaching general availability in December 2025 and listing named consumer brands as customers. It is still an eight person team, no priced round beyond YC is verified, and the outcome is open. Sources do not support a clear success or failure factor yet.
notes: Funding is only on aggregators: CB Insights says 500K USD convertible note in January 2022, VCBacked says 500K pre-seed in March 2022, Clera says 6.8M total (outlier). All unverified, so no rounds are recorded; this is not evidence of zero funding. No dated competitor source found near the 2022 batch (a demo day article from April 2022 did not mention Cotera), so the list is empty. Pivot date is from an aggregator. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff news found.
